runtime_changes: NVCF and NVIDIA canary failures are classified as provider-degraded advisory signals and return scheduler-safe HTTP 200 while preserving failure details in the body and logs.
releaseGateProbe now checks the canonical 7ya.io build marker with a bounded no-cache runtime probe instead of running AI-heavy visual audits inside cron.
Visual acceptance remains a separate manual release gate through /api/visual-acceptance and is explicitly non-blocking for cron health.
cron.json now schedules only agent-mesh-hourly and meta-sync-hourly; the failing NVCF canary is no longer a source-scheduled job.

scheduler.interpretation: Disabled historical scheduler records are not current cron.json authority.

domain.direct_browser_api_transport: unresolved: direct /api/* requests may surface SPA HTML; this is not used as the sole release proof

github_provenance.rule: Do not deploy GitHub main over AppDeploy v97 until the full runtime tree is exported and compared.
